description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from confocal laser scanning microscopy of neuronal cultures studying synaptic structure and pharmacological perturbation.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record (e.g., image ID, sample ID, or analysis ROI ID).

specimen_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the biological specimen/culture batch.

collection_date.descr: Date the sample or image was collected/acquired, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

strain.descr: Animal strain or line, e.g., C57BL/6J, Sprague-Dawley.

sex.descr: Biological sex of donor animal, if known; use controlled terms such as male, female, unknown.

age_or_developmental_stage.descr: Age or developmental stage of the donor at tissue collection, e.g., P0, P7, embryonic day 18, adult.

brain_region.descr: Brain region used to derive neurons, e.g., hippocampus, cortex, striatum.

cell_type.descr: Primary cell type or neuronal subtype, e.g., primary cortical neurons, hippocampal neurons, GABAergic neurons.

culture_system.descr: Culture format used for the sample, e.g., primary dissociated culture, organotypic slice culture, co-culture.

days_in_vitro.descr: Number of days in culture at the time of treatment or imaging.

plating_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Cell plating density in cells per square centimeter at seeding.

substrate_coating.descr: Surface coating used for culture attachment, e.g., poly-D-lysine, laminin, poly-L-lysine.

fixation_used.descr: Whether the sample was chemically fixed before imaging.

fixative.descr: Fixative used, if applicable, e.g., paraformaldehyde 4%, glutaraldehyde 0.1%.

permeabilization_method.descr: Permeabilization reagent and conditions used for staining, if applicable.

labeling_method.descr: Staining or labeling approach used, e.g., immunofluorescence, genetically encoded reporter, live-cell dye.

postsynaptic_marker.descr: Marker used to identify the postsynaptic density, e.g., PSD-95, Homer1, Shank3, GFP-tagged PSD protein.

presynaptic_marker.descr: Optional presynaptic marker used for synapse identification, e.g., synapsin, bassoon.

pharmacological_treatment_name.descr: Name of the neurotransmitter receptor antagonist or other pharmacological agent applied.

treatment_target.descr: Primary molecular target or pathway of the treatment, e.g., NMDA receptor, AMPA receptor, GABA-A receptor.

treatment_class.descr: Pharmacological class, e.g., antagonist, agonist, inhibitor.

treatment_concentration.descr: Applied treatment concentration in the stated unit.

treatment_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for treatment concentration, e.g., uM, nM, mg/mL.

vehicle_control.descr: Vehicle used to deliver the treatment, e.g., DMSO, saline, water.

treatment_duration_minutes.descr: Duration of exposure to the treatment in minutes.

treatment_timing_relative_to_imaging.descr: When treatment occurred relative to imaging, e.g., pre-treatment, during imaging, post-fixation.

wash_steps_count.descr: Number of wash steps performed after treatment or staining.

imaging_platform.descr: Microscopy platform used, e.g., confocal laser scanning microscope.

objective_numerical_aperture.descr: Numerical aperture of the objective lens.

objective_immersion.descr: Immersion medium for the objective, e.g., oil, water, glycerol.

objective_correction.descr: Objective correction type, e.g., Plan-Apochromat, Fluor, Apo.

laser_wavelengths_nm.descr: Excitation laser wavelength(s) used, in nanometers. Store as a comma-separated string if multiple wavelengths were used.

laser_power_percent.descr: Laser power at acquisition, expressed as percent of maximum power if available.

detector_type.descr: Detector type used, e.g., PMT, HyD, GaAsP.

emission_bands_nm.descr: Emission detection band(s), in nanometers, e.g., 500-550; 600-650. Store multiple bands as a string if needed.

scan_mode.descr: Scanning mode used, e.g., sequential, bidirectional, resonant.

pixel_size_x_um.descr: Pixel size in the x dimension, in micrometers per pixel.

pixel_size_y_um.descr: Pixel size in the y dimension, in micrometers per pixel.

z_stack_depth_um.descr: Total depth of the acquired z-stack, in micrometers.

number_of_z_slices.descr: Number of z-sections in the 3D stack.

scan_speed.descr: Scanner speed or dwell time setting, as recorded by the instrument/software.

line_averaging.descr: Number of line averages used during acquisition.

frame_averaging.descr: Number of frame averages used during acquisition.

acquisition_software.descr: Software used to acquire the images, e.g., Zen, LAS X, Leica Application Suite.

reconstruction_software.descr: Software used for 3D reconstruction and/or deconvolution.

deconvolution_applied.descr: Whether deconvolution was applied to the raw image data.

analysis_software.descr: Software used for quantification or morphological analysis.

roi_type.descr: Type of region of interest analyzed, e.g., dendritic spine, synaptic punctum, junctional ROI.

synapse_type.descr: Synapse class if known, e.g., excitatory, inhibitory, mixed.

morphological_metric_name.descr: Name of the primary morphological metric measured, e.g., PSD area, spine volume, synapse length.

morphological_metric_value.descr: Numeric value of the primary morphological metric.

morphological_metric_unit.descr: Unit for the primary morphological metric, e.g., um2, um3, um.

secondary_metric_name.descr: Optional secondary morphological metric name, if multiple measures are stored.

secondary_metric_value.descr: Numeric value of the secondary morphological metric.

secondary_metric_unit.descr: Unit for the secondary morphological metric.

temperature_c.descr: Temperature during live imaging or incubation, in degrees Celsius.

co2_percent.descr: CO2 concentration during live imaging or incubation, as percent.

humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity during live imaging or incubation, as percent.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to this record, including deviations from protocol or important context.
